Definition: Does the government maintain a digital address register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching address register, national addressing system, digital addressing.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 'No' is not supported by evidence and is contradicted by it: Algeria's Ministry of Interior (MICLAT), with the Algerian Space Agency (ASAL), operates the Référentiel National d'Adressage (RNA), a digitised national addressing database built on a GIS platform (SIG-Web, deployed since 2022). The Oran pilot wilaya produced c.311,000 official, standardised, geolocated addresses (completed before mid-2025), and nationwide generalisation to further wilayas (Bouira, Sidi Bel Abbès, Constantine, Ouargla) began in May-June 2025. Revised to 'Partially deployed' (4) as of June 2025, since the register is operational in at least one wilaya with active rollout under way but not yet nationwide.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital population register?
Comments: No credible evidence found after searching for population register, national population database digital, civil register of persons, Ministry of Interior databases, World Bank ID4D, UN CRVS reports. Biometric National ID (CNIBE) exists but no dedicated population register.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 'No' is not supported and is contradicted by evidence: the Ministry of Interior's own 2019 ID4Africa presentation describes an operational 'Registre National de la Population' — a reference identity platform keyed by a National Identification Number (NIN, generated automatically from civil-status data) that links CNIBE, passport, driving licence, vehicle registration and civil-status records across all 1,541 communes. The underlying automated national civil-status database (102m records) was already confirmed 'totally automated' nationwide by a ministry official in 2014, and citizen-facing e-services (services.interieur.gov.dz) drawing on it are live today. Revised to 'Fully deployed nationwide' (5); the original comment appears to have conflated the population register with a separate concept and missed this well-documented, government-sourced system.
